items.title: Slide Hampton interviewed by Monk Rowe, West Orange, New Jersey, July 30, 2003
items.q: But I’ve also recorded with Nat. I did a very bad CD with Nat too, I played very badly on that.

items.q: Not much but I have worked with them... I worked on the same concert with Miles when Cannonball was there... I’ve also recorded with Nat.

ctx.x: them all with conviction. It was one of the most fantastic things I ever saw. He could play country-western, he could play the blues, he could play old style, he could play traditional, he could play straight ahead, he could play like Trane. It was unbelievable. And the guys were actually mad at him because the guy could play so many styles they hired him for everything. He could read everything in sight. Tony’s got a lot of that in him.
